name: Audible
jobs: stream a catalog of audiobooks you haven't bought
verdict_reason: Audiobookshelf is a gorgeous server for audiobooks you own — and Audible's product is a catalog you don't. Same verdict as Spotify: self-hosting replaces the player, and the player was never the subscription.
what_you_lose: The catalog and the credits model — DRM'd purchases don't move into your server

what_broke: The image ships wget but not curl — a curl-based healthcheck reports unhealthy forever while the server is fine
